count.description: Signups on that day (0 for gap days).

referrer.description: Free-text referrer value; null groups entries without one.

action.description: Action to apply to every id.

ids.description: Entry UUIDs to act on in this batch. Capped at 100 per call; the request is processed serially and per-row results are returned. De-duped server-side.

send_email.description: Whether to send the approval email with the invite link baked in. Defaults to `true`. Ignored for approve/reject.

requested.description: Number of unique ids processed (after de-dupe).

code.description: HTTP-style status code for the per-row failure.

recaptcha_token.description: reCAPTCHA v3 token; verified server-side when the waitlist has settings.recaptcha_site_key

referral_code.description: Referral code from a prior signup; bumps that signup’s position when honoured

variant_id.description: Variant id this submission was attributed to. Customer frontends fetch the active variant from `GET /v1/waitlists/:workspaceSlug/:waitlistSlug` and round-trip it here on POST so per-variant conversion can be computed without a separate impressions table.

copy.description: Copy overrides. Recognised keys: display_name, description, confirmation_message. Unknown keys are dropped on the public render.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale tag. For ab variants this is the locale they target; for locale variants this is the locale they serve. Case is normalised on the public side.

weight.description: Relative weight inside the ab pool. Ignored when kind=locale. Default 1.

description.description: Description returned in the public waitlist payload — customer frontends typically render it under the display name on their signup form.

settings.description: Waitlist settings (max_entries, approval_required, custom_fields, confirmation_message, referral_boost)

active.description: Disabled webhooks store events but never deliver

url.description: Destination URL (must be https in prod)

event_types.description: Event types from `GET …/webhooks/event-types`. Empty or omitted means every event, including types added later.

url.description: Where to send events: an absolute https:// URL on a public host.

mail_checked.description: Whether the sender domain and template names were checked against Mail on this read (results are cached for up to 60 seconds). `false` when Mail could not be asked, for example because the caller cannot read Mail domains or templates; nothing is reported missing on an unchecked item.

missing.description: What is missing, in a fixed order. `not_enabled`: notifications are off. `no_sender_domain`: no sender domain is chosen, or the chosen one no longer exists in Mail (or is receive-only). `sender_domain_unverified`: the sender domain is not verified in Mail yet. `no_sender_address`: no From address is set. `no_template`: at least one email has no template, or its template was deleted in Mail; `missing_templates` says which. Empty when `state` is `ready`.

missing_templates.description: The emails whose template is not set or no longer exists in Mail: `welcome` (on signup), `approved`, `rejected`.

state.description: `ready`: every piece is in place and emails go out. `incomplete`: notifications are on but something in `missing` stops some or all emails. `off`: notifications are off (`notifications_via_envoi = false`), so Waitlist sends no email and webhooks are the way to reach signups.

count.description: Total number of entries on the waitlist.

code.description: Stable error code for programmatic handling, when the route sets one.

message.description: Human-readable error message. May be a class-validator array on 400.

status_code.description: HTTP status code echoed in the body.

send_email.description: Send the approval email with the Auth invite link baked in

entry.description: The entry row after `invited_at` / `invited_to_app_slug` were stamped.

invite_id.description: Auth invite id created in the linked app.

invite_url.description: Invite acceptance URL, when the Auth app returned one. Baked into the approval email when send_email is enabled.

attempt_number.description: Which attempt this was for the event: 1 for the first delivery, then 2 to 7 for the automatic retries (1m, 5m, 30m, 2h, 6h and 24h after each failure). Retries keep the same `event_id`. A test or a replay is numbered in the same sequence.

event_id.description: Id of the event (`evt_…`), the same across retries.

status_code.description: HTTP status from the destination; null when the request errored before a response.

pagination.description: Always one page (an endpoint limit applies).

has_more.description: True iff another page exists; if true, pass `next_cursor` on the next request.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. `null` when no more pages are available.

effective_position.description: Visible position after applying the referral boost — "you would be #N if approved now". Equals `position` at signup time (no referrals yet).

position.description: Immutable signup position (1-based order of signup).

referral_code.description: Referral code for this signup. Build your referral URL from it and pass it as `referral_code` on subsequent signups.

count.description: Referral count that unlocks the reward.

reward.description: Reward description shown to the signer-up.

milestones.description: Milestones sorted by count, ascending. Empty when the waitlist has no referral rewards configured.

key.description: Stable field key. Submit values under this key in the entry `metadata` object.

canonical_workspace_slug.description: Canonical workspace slug. When the request URL used a stale slug, compare with the URL slug and 301-redirect.

confirmation_message.description: Message to show after a successful signup.

display_name.description: Display name (active variant copy wins over the stored name).

recaptcha_site_key.description: reCAPTCHA v3 site key. When non-null, POST .../entries requires a `recaptcha_token`.

variant.description: Active A/B or locale variant served for this request; null when none configured.

workspace_slug.description: Workspace slug the request resolved against.

id.description: Active variant id. Round-trip it as `variant_id` on POST .../entries to attribute the signup.

attempts.description: One attempt per endpoint it was sent to.

grace_hours.description: Hours the previous secret keeps signing too (0 ends it now).

event_type.description: Which event to send; its catalogue example is the `data`.

last_7_days.description: Emails not sent in the last 7 days because the setup was incomplete (`email_setup.missing`). Emails not sent because notifications are off are not counted.

last_at.description: When the most recent counted email was skipped; null when none in the last 7 days.

event.description: Event type to fire as a synthetic test

waitlist_id.description: Accepted for older clients and ignored: the test delivers the event's example payload from `GET …/webhooks/event-types`.

approved_template_name.description: Mail template name used for entry.approved notifications. Must already exist in the workspace template store.

brand_logo_url.description: Logo URL returned in the public waitlist payload. Customer frontends render it on their own signup form.

brand_name.description: Brand name returned in the public waitlist payload. Customer frontends render it on their own signup form.

default_heimdall_app_slug.description: Auth consumer-app slug to invite approved entries into. null clears the link.

default_sender_address.description: Verified sender address used as the From envelope on Waitlist notifications. Must belong to default_sender_domain_id. null clears the override.

default_sender_domain_id.description: Mail domain UUID to use as default sender for Waitlist notifications. null clears the override.

notifications_via_envoi.description: Route Waitlist notifications through the Mail service (workspace sender domain + per-event template selection) instead of staying silent. Requires default_sender_domain_id, default_sender_address, and a template name for every supported event. Default false; when off, Waitlist sends no notification emails and the customer is expected to handle email via the webhook lane.

rejected_template_name.description: Mail template name used for entry.rejected notifications. Must already exist in the workspace template store.

welcome_template_name.description: Mail template name used for entry.created notifications. Must already exist in the workspace template store.

enabled.description: Switch it on or off. Switching on also clears an automatic disable.

event_types.description: Replaces the subscription. Event types from `GET …/webhooks/event-types`. Empty or omitted means every event, including types added later.

viral_coefficient.description: referrals / total_entries — the K-factor proxy. 0 when no entries.

settings.description: Waitlist settings (max_entries, approval_required, custom_fields, confirmation_message, referral_boost).

default_heimdall_app_slug.description: Auth consumer-app slug approved entries are invited into.

default_sender_domain_id.description: Mail domain UUID used as default sender for Waitlist notifications.

email_setup.description: Whether Waitlist emails can go out and, if not, what is missing. Computed on the server on every read.

notifications_via_envoi.description: Whether Waitlist notifications are routed through the Mail service.
